rationale: The dossier accurately encodes dyadic matrix dimensions, the ordinary equation AR-RB=-C, the four block signs and dependency graph, variational positive separation, and exact-versus-computed forward errors. However, the theorem changes the proof boundary: P10SylRRun assumes the page-86 local estimates, separation inheritance, an attained worst-case envelope, and an unsupported scalar base bound, then concludes a custom exact constant-2 Frobenius bound. The source instead derives first-order estimates from a stable multiplication model and states equation (20) only up to big-O before classifying the actual SylR algorithm by Definition 3.1. Certified runs are constructible, so the proposition is not vacuous, but its narrower antecedent is not genuine strength and neither implication holds.
